messages:
sylvie: Quick follow-up from the PG+KV timeout postmortem — we need owners for runbook edits, short mitigation steps, and a playback checklist for next oncall. Keep items tiny.

pm_lee: please list owners + ETA so I can tag the postmortem follow-ups.

sylvie: suggested split:
- DB triage commands + thresholds -> harper (48h)
- Pager pre-check + 5min playback -> tony (48h)
- Scheduler throttle analysis -> harper (7d)
- Routing fallback note -> infra (sylvie) (7d)

harper: i'll do the DB section. will include both local shell + kubectl variants and exact thresholds. PR ETA 2 days. example snippet i'll add:
`psql -c "select now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp() as lag;"`

tony: pager edit: add a 5min DM pre-escalation step, include quick log dump commands and exporter checks. i'll add the playback (5-10m) script for handoffs. PR ETA 48h.

sre_bot: Incident auto-link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026/pg-kv-timeout-1763449000

sylvie: recurring pattern note: 3 partial timeouts in ~10w during bulk imports/reindexes. runbook should include 'when to throttle background jobs' with a scheduler hook example.

harper: will validate a safe default (suggested: delay big jobs if DB QPS > 1700 for 5m) during my analysis. findings in ISSUE-1622.

tony: owners please open GH issues and drop numbers here so pm_lee can mark the postmortem. cadence: update this thread every 3 business days until PRs merged.

pm_lee: thanks — small ask: top of runbook add quick-links to dashboards + the incident doc. That materially speeds triage.

sylvie: good call. i'll create follow-up issues and add to postmortem. will ping here when done.
